item.title: Childhood Pretend Play Was Basically Adult Training
item.description: Pretending to smoke with pretzel sticks and drink with apple juice, she jokes about preparing for adulthood while still in elementary school. A hilarious throwback to childhood make-believe.

item.title: When Therapy Makes You Think You Can Fix Anyone
item.description: A humorous take on being so invested in therapy and personal growth that you start believing you can help even the most unexpected people work through their problems.

item.title: POV you ask the universe for a sign
item.description: Tammin Sursok asks the universe for a sign to help with her anxiety, but the answer is a blunt reminder to drink some water. A funny take on looking for signs in everyday life.
